_doc.intent: Task 144 release A/B matrix r2 after packet 006/007 feedback. Adds truth-cache prerequisite steps and broadens the two experimental knobs before 50k/100k spend.

query_modes.ratio125: ordinary sweep as a ceiling plus ec_spire.probe_distance_ratio=1.25; retained as the falsified over-pruning baseline from packet 007

_doc.sweep_rationale: Uses [8,16,32,64,96] rather than the registered ec_spire default [8,16,24,32] because packet 007 showed 10k reaches >=0.99 only around nprobe 32 and the ratio arms need a high fixed ceiling to reveal whether the ratio band, not nprobe, is binding.
_doc.truth_cache_prereq: Each scale has a recall step truth-cache-{scale}-k10 that produces ${artifact_dir}/truth-{scale}-k10.json before spire-pipeline consumers; truth cache files are generated artifacts and should remain uncommitted per AGENTS.md.
_doc.reporting: Suite result rows derive spire_pipeline_row_scan from candidate_sum/queries/corpus_rows, and bench storage emits SPIRE mean_replicas_per_vector from ec_spire_index_health_snapshot.

steps.name: precheck-release-profile
args: LOAD 'ecaz'; SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, ecaz_build_profile() AS ecaz_build_profile;
